summary: Create an OAuth2 application in AAP (2.5/2.6: gateway /access/applications; 2.4: controller /#/applications) named automation-dashboard-sso with authorization-code grant, Confidential client and redirect URI https://<dashboard>/auth-callback; create a read-scope token and edit the inventory, replacing host.example.com and TODO passwords.
questions: How do I create the OAuth application for automation dashboard?
What redirect URI does automation dashboard use?
What token scope does automation dashboard need?

answer_card.title: OAuth2 app for automation dashboard
answer_card.answer_md:
In AAP 2.5/2.6 go to `https://<gateway>/access/applications` (2.4: `https://<controller>/#/applications`) and add:
- Name: `automation-dashboard-sso`
- Authorization grant type: authorization-code
- Organization: Default
- Redirect URIs: `https://<dashboard-fqdn>/auth-callback`
- Client type: Confidential

Put the `client_id`/`client_secret` in the inventory. Then create a user token for that application with **read** scope and keep the access and refresh tokens for `clusters.yaml`.
